requirements.quote: List all M/WBEs used during the quarter, providing all requested information in appropriate columns.
requirements.text: Provide a list of all M/WBEs used during the quarter.

requirements.quote: In the event that an M/WBE is used more than one time during a quarter, list the M/WBE only once for each expenditure category.
requirements.text: List each M/WBE only once per expenditure category, even if used multiple times.

requirements.quote: Use the Expenditure Code defined at the top of the form to indicate the category of expenditures for which the M/WBE was used.
requirements.text: Use the provided Expenditure Code to categorize M/WBE expenditures.

requirements.quote: Column A Total Amount of Actual Expenditures in Report Period: Enter the amount ($) for each Expenditure Code made during report period under this contract.
requirements.text: Enter the total expenditures for each Expenditure Code in Column A.

requirements.quote: Column B MBE Subcontracting Expenditures: Enter the amount for each Expenditure Code with registered Minority Owned Business Enterprises made during the report period under this contract.
requirements.text: Enter MBE subcontracting expenditures for each Expenditure Code in Column B.

requirements.quote: Column C WBE Subcontracting Expenditures: Enter the amount of expenditures for each Expenditure Code with registered Women Owned Business Enterprises made during the report period under this contract.
requirements.text: Enter WBE subcontracting expenditures for each Expenditure Code in Column C.

requirements.quote: Column D MWBE Dual Subcontracting Expenditures: Enter the amount of expenditures for each Expenditure Code with registered Minority and Women Owned Business Enterprises made during the report period under this contract.
requirements.text: Enter MWBE dual subcontracting expenditures for each Expenditure Code in Column D.
